text:
Maria (AM): Quick sync — AcmeX asked for a joint co-sell sandbox to validate SSO, request routing to a dedicated pool, and a perf+cost estimate for a 50k tokens/day scenario. Need a short runbook and answers for their security questionnaire by EOD.
Sam Eng: Sounds good. Which model family and region? EU preferred?
Maria (AM): They asked for Redwood-2-small equivalent and EU hosting. They mentioned VPC peering preference but are open to hosted if we clarify data residency/egress.
Liam - SE: For reliable p95 <200ms at 256 tokens we should provision a tiny dedicated pool rather than shared hosted capacity. For a quick sandbox: 1 dedicated node (a2-large-equivalent) with autoscale off should be enough to validate routing and SSO.
Anya (PS): I can prepare a 10-15 min enablement deck and a short demo script. We should include a preflight checklist: 1) SAML metadata, 2) redirect URIs, 3) test users, 4) allowlist IPs/net ranges.
Sam Eng: Security answers: data-at-rest encrypted, KMS-managed keys, logs retained 30d by default. Point them to our SOC2 artifact bundle for formal requests. On-prem/private deployment will need a separate quote and lead time.
Maria (AM): Pricing: they want a ballpark for 50k tokens/day (hosted) to include in the co-sell proposal tonight. Can someone give a quick monthly estimate?
Liam - SE: Ballpark: with batching & KV caching, 50k/day ~1.5M tokens/month. Cost varies by model tier and quantization. I'll put a conservative estimate and a higher-case number in the runbook (will finalize when model/quantization chosen). Also propose 2-week trial credit for sandbox telemetry access.
Sam Eng: SSO details we need: uid, email, name attributes. We'll provide an SP metadata snippet and an IdP metadata endpoint. Example ACS: 
``n<AssertionConsumerService Binding="POST" Location="https://sandbox.acme.redwood/saml/acs"/>
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://sandbox.acme.redwood">...
```
Liam - SE: I'll create a GitHub runbook with terraform snippets to bootstrap the test tenant, the routing policy, and perf steps. Snippet example:
``nresource "redwood_tenant" "acmex_sandbox" {
  name = "acmex-sandbox"
  region = "eu-west-1"
  model = "redwood-2-small"
  dedicated = true
}
```
deploy-bot: sandbox-acmex-sandbox provisioned in eu-west-1 (id: sandbox-cc34). Logs: https://internal.deploy/logs/sandbox-cc34 :white_check_mark:
Anya (PS): I'll include a short perf run using locust/JMeter and the demo steps: 1) SSO login, 2) route to dedicated pool, 3) show latency + cost dashboards, 4) highlight fallback policy. Can someone add the locust commands to the runbook?
Liam - SE: Adding perf run header and example command:
``nlocust -f perf/locustfile.py --host https://sandbox.acme.redwood
```
Maria (AM): Action items: Liam - GH runbook + provisional cost numbers (EOD). Anya - deck + demo script (tomorrow AM). Sam - security questionnaire draft + SOC2 pointer. I'll draft an SOW once numbers are in and send to AcmeX.
Sam Eng: I'll drop the security draft into the runbook PR.
Liam - SE: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pulls/325 (runbook, terraform, perf notes).
Maria (AM): Great — once PR is merged I'll send the sandbox link and the co-sell proposal to AcmeX. Thanks team :pray:
